sector.name: Lagunillas, Yobilo y Coronel Centro
sector.note: Pilot service area defined by the Evacua project (owner decision 2026-10-04): one rectangle from Lagunillas (north) through Yobilo to the centre of Coronel (south). It is not an official administrative boundary; neighbouring areas inside the rectangle, such as Schwager, are covered too.
